What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.23

  • The equalizer keeps hearing your music when you switch to AirPods or headphones, when a browser starts playing in another tab, and when your music app takes a moment to start its sound.
  • When ShawNotch can't hear your music (no permission, or macOS before 14.2), the equalizer no longer keeps checking 30 times a second.
  • Moving the playback line right after pressing play or pause no longer jumps back.
